item.title: Strike Ends, Bay Street Murder, Teacher Overpayments
item.ns0:title: Strike Ends, Bay Street Murder, Teacher Overpayments
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, public school administrators return to work after a disruptive one-day strike as union leaders hold marathon talks with government officials to address critical staffing shortages. Just steps from Parliament, a shocking early morning shooting on Bay Street leaves a young man dead and raises deep safety concerns for downtown workers and visitors. Meanwhile, investigators are probing the accidental overpayment of more than a quarter-million dollars in salaries to over a hundred educators, resulting in multiple guilty pleas in court this week. Plus, we bring you major updates on upcoming government housing projects across the islands and a historic milestone in the sports world as a Bahamian baseball star makes his big league debut.
